description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing of the 'git' build-in filesystem monitor (FSMonitor). It contains setup routines for repositories, functions to enable or disable FSMonitor and untracked cache, and various test cases to measure repository status under different configurations. The script orchestrates complex performance benchmarks, including repository setup, modifications, and cleanups, specifically tailored to evaluate the behavior of FSMonitor in conjunction with other git features.

methods.name: enable_uc
methods.description: Enables untracked cache on the repository by configuring core.untrackedcache and updating the index accordingly.

methods.name: disable_uc
methods.description: Disables untracked cache on the repository by resetting the configuration and updating the index.

methods.name: start_fsm
methods.description: Starts the FSMonitor daemon, enables the fsmonitor core setting, and updates the index to use fsmonitor.

methods.name: stop_fsm
methods.description: Stops the FSMonitor daemon, unsets the core.fsmonitor setting, and updates the index to disable fsmonitor.

methods.name: do_status
methods.description: Performs git status command under timing/performance measurement with a specific message.

methods.name: do_matrix
methods.description: Configures a test matrix with different combinations of untracked cache and FSMonitor, performs a series of repository manipulations, and records timing outcomes.
